services.name: Jet Ski
services.desc: From the canopy, the bay looks like a painting. From a ski, it's a racetrack. The hour-long guided ride leaves from the same pier as your flight: idle out past the moorings, then the guide opens the zone and the painting gets loud. One or two riders per ski, drivers 18 and up, and Florida's boater card is a twenty-minute phone course the desk helps with at check-in. Flyers who add the ski afterward all say some version of the same thing - the flight shows you the bay, the ski lets you answer back. The operational details our captains brief at the dock - covered here so you can plan. Fuel is included in every rate. Tax & marina fee are added at check-in for every booking, regardless of rate.

services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Six to ten minutes at 400 feet where the boat noise disappears and the bay does the talking. This is the flight we've flown since 2007, off the same pier, under the same yellow flags. An hour on the water, a slow winch up to 400 feet, and the moment every flyer remembers: the wind steadies, the engine fades, and Biscayne Bay unrolls underneath you - turquoise flats, the Grove's green shoreline, downtown stacked on the horizon. Up to three fly together on one canopy. Feet stay dry on the boat deck at both ends, unless you request the dip. Ages 5 and up, no swimming needed, 450 lbs combined per flight. services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Five riders, one yellow tube, and a tow driver with a sense of humor. Thirty minutes, endless footage. Every group has them: the ones who watched the parasail go up and asked what else there is. Put them on the banana. Four to five riders, a tow rope, and thirty minutes of the marina's highest laughs-per-dollar ratio. The driver reads the tube - gentle arcs for the cautious, whip turns for the brave - and the whole thing runs from the same dock while the flyers in your party are up on the canopy. services.name: Boat Tour
services.desc: Thirty minutes of spins and wake-jumps with a captain who knows where the bay lets him play. The flight is serene. This is not. Thirty minutes on a performance boat with a captain who reads your group and drives accordingly - families get swoops, adrenaline crews get airtime off the wakes. It seats up to 20, prices per rider, and it's the easy add-on for the half of your group that wants their hair blown back after floating over the bay. Same pier, same water, very different volume.
